# `hyperstac-permutation`

Quantify HyPERSTAC embedding sensitivity to channel zeroing and pixel shuffling

- Wrapper: [`job_hyperstac_permutation.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_hyperstac_permutation.sh)
- Conda environment: `hyperstac`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.hyperstac_permutation`

## Inputs

- HyPERSTAC patch metadata, patch arrays, representation AnnData, and encoder weights

## Outputs

- hyperstac.asset_folder/permutation_sensitivity AnnData and managed sensitivity tables

## Configuration

- general, hyperstac, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl hyperstac-permutation
```
